name: Like burst
what: A heart pops (it overshoots and settles), a ring goes out, small particles burst and fade, a +1 floats up and the count ticks up; then it beats gently.

learned_from.what: the heart button popping with a burst of particles
the heart on a pink disc, a pop on every change

motion: pop to 1.25 in 7 f, settle back.out 9 f; ring 16 f; particles 18 f (power3.out); +1 floats 24 f; a heartbeat every 30 f
